Revise the applicability structure so only explicitly applicable role-qualified crew members are checked, while preserving the matrix branches and matching STCW credential checks. Also avoid requiring the same training record through both hasCrewTrainingRecord and hasPolarTrainingRecord unless the requirement independently requires both relationships; use the declared relationship/evidence boundary without duplicating the record fact.
